## Detailed Case Studies & Technical Architecture

### 1. Matchmade Indonesia (2024 - Present)
- Role: Product Manager
- Domain: Enterprise B2B SaaS, Financial Reconciliation & AI Document Extraction
- Live Product: https://matchmade.io/
- Context & Problem:
  Corporate finance and accounting departments spent up to five business days per month reconciling millions of accounting entries against diverse third-party statements (bank statements, ERP general ledgers, payment gateway settlement files, supplier invoices). Discrepancies led to delayed financial reporting, audit risk, and high manual labor costs.
- Product Architecture & Technical Decisions:
  1. Multi-Table Matching Logic: Built an adaptable rule engine allowing user-defined matching tolerance thresholds, multi-column fuzzy joins, and composite keys.
  2. Stream Processing Architecture: Re-architected data ingestion to support chunked database streaming and virtualized frontend table views, scaling transaction throughput from 11 GB/month to 34 GB/month (3x capacity) without client memory crashes.
  3. AI Document Extraction (Docling PoC): Integrated Docling-based document understanding for extracting complex tabular records from unstructured multi-page PDF statements into clean relational records, bypassing manual keying.
  4. Security & Isolation: Enforced tenant-isolated Row Level Security (RLS) in PostgreSQL/Supabase, guaranteeing zero cross-tenant data exposure.
- Measurable Outcomes:
  - IDR 1.2 Billion annual cost savings per enterprise customer.
  - Reduced financial close duration by 80% (from 5 business days down to 1 single day).
  - Scaled monthly pipeline data volume by 300% (11 GB to 34 GB per month).

### 2. PegiPegi (2022 - 2023)
- Role: Product Manager
- Domain: Consumer Travel Marketplace (OTA - Flights, Hotels, Ground Transportation)
- Context & Problem:
  Payment infrastructure had remained untouched for two years. As customer volume scaled, gateway timeouts caused transaction drops and refund delays. Duplicate user accounts created high promotional and messaging waste.
- Product Architecture & Technical Decisions:
  1. Resilient Payment Pipeline: Implemented an asynchronous webhook retry architecture backed by idempotent transaction tokens, preventing duplicate customer debits during bank gateway latency spikes.
  2. Account Deduplication Engine: Developed an identity graph algorithm matching phone numbers, device UUIDs, and payment method hashes to detect and consolidate redundant accounts.
  3. WhatsApp Business Notification Channel: Migrated critical booking confirmations and payment reminders from SMS to WhatsApp Business API, boosting open rates to 75% and reducing communication overhead by 6%.
  4. Internal Refund Arbitration Console: Designed specialized CSO dispute resolution views that accelerated complex refund approvals from 3 days to under 4 hours.
- Measurable Outcomes:
  - 85% reduction in customer service refund processing turnaround.
  - 50% decrease in redundant account creation, saving half of messaging quotas.
  - 40% reduction in checkout completion time.
  - +10% increase in newly transacting customer cohorts.

### 3. AdaKerja (2021 - 2022)
- Role: Product Manager
- Domain: Blue-Collar Recruitment Platform & SME Commerce
- Context & Problem:
  Low payment funnel conversion on mobile web due to unstable 3G/4G connectivity across Tier 2/3 Indonesian regions. Development velocity was hindered by conflicting backlogs across three separate engineering squads.
- Product Architecture & Technical Decisions:
  1. Progressive Mobile Checkout: Designed a lightweight, single-page checkout flow with local client-side form caching so users on unstable mobile networks did not lose their application data upon packet drops.
  2. Squad Alignment & North Star Framework: Replaced disconnected squad backlogs with a unified product roadmap centered on a single metric: verified candidate activations.
- Measurable Outcomes:
  - +60% uplift in payment click-through rate (CTR).
  - Unified three cross-functional squads behind synchronized release cadences.

## Tools Lab Applications

1. LLM Token & Margin Simulator (`/tools/llm-token-economics`):
   Allows AI product leaders to simulate token usage, context window consumption, and unit economics across OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source models with real-time margin sensitivity sliders.

2. PRD Prompt Compiler & Gherkin Engine (`/tools/prd-prompt-compiler`):
   Transforms natural language product briefs into production-grade Gherkin user stories with explicit negative error cases and authorization boundaries.

3. Multilingual ASR Model Selector (`/tools/asr-model-selector`):
   Comparative evaluation matrix benchmarking Whisper, Conformer, and regional foundation models for Southeast Asian code-switching dialects and mixed-language environments.

4. CalSnap (`https://calendar-snap.vercel.app/`):
   AI agent utility converting calendar event screenshots and message snippets into structured Google Calendar entries and downloadable .ics files.
